title: Spectral Equality for Novikov Integrability: Recursive Criticality and Unbounded Asymptotic Depth
summary: We determine the finiteness boundary of the Novikov exponential moment for a one-dimensional constant-volatility mean-reverting diffusion. A localised change of measure cancels the squared drift and leaves a Brownian Feynman-Kac functional with potential $q/2$, where $q=-λ'$. If $q(θ+y)\simκ_\infty y^2$, the exact spectral boundary is $κ_\inftyσ^2T^2=π^2$; for cubic drift it becomes $cσ^2T^2=π^2/3$, and equality is divergent.
